$description: ListingClarion design tokens — three-tier, W3C DTCG. Primitives are theme-agnostic; components read only the semantic tier. Naming: category.role.variant.state.

primitive.$description: Raw values. Never referenced by components.

instant.$description: State flips with no spatial change

ui.$description: All UI text and body copy, 400-600

display-xl.$description: Screen hero, marketing · weight follows the theme display weight (800), already baked into the CSS shorthand

display.$description: Dashboard greeting, KPI value · weight follows the theme display weight (800), already baked into the CSS shorthand

channel.$description: Per-platform accent. Chips, dots and 20-28px marks only — never large surfaces, never body text.

flagship.$description: Clarion (Flagship) — Clean, calm, photography-first. Signal teal used sparingly as the one bright thing on a low-chroma slate page. The default for most agents.

accent.$description: accent.default carries information alone at 3:1. accent.bold is the bright signal FILL and never carries its own boundary — it must sit inside an accent.boldEdge outline (markers), an action.primary.text ring (signal lamp), or take accent.boldEdge instead when drawn as a bare rule. accent.boldText is the only ink legal on accent.bold; accent.boldEdge is the only accent value legal as small text.

focus.$description: Two-tone focus indicator: inner band focus.ring, outer band focus.contrast. No single colour clears 3:1 against BOTH the page and the orange primary button, so both bands ship together. Do not collapse to one outline.

bold.$description: Broadcast (High-energy) — Loud and fast. Broadcast orange carries large surfaces, tight radii and hard-edged elevation. Light mode sits on warm neutrals; dark mode drops onto cobalt ink, which turns the orange complementary rather than monochrome-warm.

heading.$description: Section headings. Cobalt on light for a quieter step below text.primary; white on dark, where a tinted heading would read as de-emphasised against the cobalt page.

component.$description: Component tokens exist only where no semantic role covers the need.

glyphRequired.$description: Status is never colour-only: glyph + label always present.

radius.$description: Points at the adopted theme; every template defines radius.sm.

min.$description: Mobile-first floor for every interactive element.

signalLamp.$description: The live-broadcast lamp: accent.bold fill on an action surface, pulsing at duration.slow.

$validation.$description: WCAG 2.1 AA for every pairing the shipped components depend on. 4.5:1 text, 3:1 UI and non-text. The focus indicator is two-tone — band rows are diagnostics; "either band" rows are the requirement.
$validation.$note: Diagnostic band rows below 3:1: 15. Expected — a two-tone ring only requires ONE band to contrast a given surface; the "either band" rows carry the requirement.
